citations.quote: As the name implies, linear regression assumes a linear relationship between the dependent and the independent variables.
We need to make the following four key assumptions to be able to draw valid conclusions from a simple linear regression model

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Multiple linear regression posits Y_i = b_0 + sum_j b_j x_{ji} + e_i with linear-in-parameters specification and the four classical assumptions (linearity, homoskedasticity, independence, normality) making OLS the best linear unbiased estimator. CFA L1 2022 R7 covers the simple-LR case (k=1) only; the multi-regressor extension is named in the F-test null.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Multiple Linear Regression Foundations
